I can do that but deleting rows is irreversible. Please confirm before I proceed.

Summary of the requested action
- Target: sheet/tab named "raw"
- Operation: delete rows 210 through 480 (inclusive)
- Consequence: those rows and all contained data/formulas will be permanently removed from the sheet; pivots/summaries that reference the sheet will update after the deletion.
- Optional precaution: I can make a backup copy of the spreadsheet or the "raw" sheet before deleting.

Please confirm by replying with one of:
- "Yes — delete rows 210-480 (no backup)" to proceed immediately, or
- "Yes — make backup and delete" to create a backup first, or
- "Cancel" to stop.
